# Keep menu selector ports scoped to each owned platform and consumer

The full 35-file 1959667 port changes owned CSS for the flatter menu node family: menu icons, text, accelerators and submenu arrows. The actual patch also adjusts platform-specific gutters/checkmarks, extension icons, Calendar reminder/category icons and Mica nesting; these are not all mechanical substitutions. Selected fixed Windows, macOS, Linux, shared and Calendar consumers have later refinements, and the old macOS accountManage.css path is absent. The separate menu.css inclusion repair is another change. This supports the named owned selector contracts only; it is not a fresh audit of Gecko-generated nodes or proof every menu works. Bug comments2/7/8 are unavailable; zero full-audit credit and no visual/native test.

Scope: Owned menu selector migration.
